lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 8 distinct light-colored vertical line segments are visible on the lateral torso. The central 5 lines exhibit relatively equidistant spacing, while the anterior and posterior segments are more isolated with lower contrast.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line and the final two posterior lines are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the mid-vertical point of the torso mass. Central lines exhibit some tapering at the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast white circular spots are located on the posterior haunch. One larger spot is positioned superior to a smaller, secondary spot on the upper hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a spiral-lyrate trajectory, emerging from the skull at a lateral-posterior angle before curving medially and anteriorly toward the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 2.5 times the combined pixel width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tips account for approximately 10-15% of the total visible longitudinal length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a prominent white facial chevron between the eyes, two white spots on the lower mandible, a dorsal white hair fringe, and high-contrast ochre coloration on the lower distal limbs.
